schema: Task list shared by every agent. status: todo | in_progress | blocked | review | done. owner: agent name, 'jonah', or null. needs_go: true = wait for Jonah's explicit go. Update your task when you start and when you hand off (see .agent/SYSTEM_PROMPT.md). Claims: an open PR titled '<TASK-ID>: ...' is the claim (SYSTEM_PROMPT 'Starting a session'). Notes say 'verified' (seen by the writer, with SHA/URL) or 'reported' (told by someone else).
